notes.title: The Hunky-Dory Lovey-Dovey DLC is Out Now!
notes.content:
Dear students of Koshian Karameruin Academy,

Thank you for enjoying From Madness with Love.

Please accept our sincerest apologies for the wait.
The Hunky-Dory Lovey-Dovey DLC is out now, adding new scenes to the game!

This adds even more chaos to the mix, including body swapping, vampirism, and new endings for everyone!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3678560/_/]Hunky-Dory Lovey-Dovey DLC[/url]

If you encounter any bugs in the DLC, please report them in the pinned Steam community thread!

[code]
[h3]DLC Streaming Guidelines[/h3]
Please refrain from streaming the DLC scenarios for a while until further notice to avoid spoilers.

However, it's totally fine to post about it on YouTube and social media as long as you don't reveal any story details! Feel free to use the hashtag #FromMadnessWithLove to share your thoughts with us and other fans!
[/code]

Until next time, bake fair!!

notes.title: The Hunky-Dory Lovey-Dovey DLC - Coming May 29!
notes.content:
Dear students of Koshian Karameruin Academy,

Thank you for enjoying From Madness with Love.

We're excited to announce that the Hunky-Dory Lovey-Dovey DLC, which adds brand new scenarios to the game, will be released on May 29, 2025!

The Hunky-Dory Lovey-Dovey DLC will contain the following...

[h3]The guys have swapped bodies?![/h3]
All four main guys have all fallen down an inconveniently placed staircase and swapped bodies with one another! They'll have to spend a whole school day in someone else's body... What could possibly go wrong?

[h3]Could he be a vampire...? Are YOU?![/h3]
Either you or the guy of your choice is a vampire?! There's no better time than this to spend some dangerous, heart-pounding time with him! And we all know what vampires do best, so get ready for some serious sucking...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42877421/b8dbce8d0c9795f1355a8cf58a373f5bc4d241b3.png[/img]
[h3]A new ending for every route![/h3]
Shy protagonists who can't work up the courage to confess to the guy of their dreams still deserve an ending to their story, and this is exactly that!

We hope you'll continue to support From Madness with Love!

notes.title: 3.2.4 Update
notes.content:
Dear students of Koshian Karameruin Academy,

We have updated the game to version 3.2.4.

This update fixes a bug that caused save data created before the previous update (3.2.3) to disappear upon launching the game after updating. In the case that you have created save data before the update and never played the update itself, you should be able to load the files with no issue.

Unfortunately however, this update will not be able to restore save data that was lost because of this bug.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused by this issue.

We hope you continue to enjoy and support From Madness with Love.

notes.title: Joining the Steam Visual Novel Fest... and Introducing Trading Cards!
notes.content:
Dear students of Koshian Karameruin Academy,

How have you been? Have you had your daily dose of madness today?
Or have you somehow cracked the code to communicating with our four boys?
Well, it doesn't matter either way, since this game is fun whether you understand them or not!

Anyway, we've joined the Steam Visual Novel Fest starting today!
Although we're participating, it hasn't been long enough since our release date, so unfortunately the game can't go on sale for the occasion. Instead, we've prepared something else: trading cards!

Collect all the cards, and also the newly designed anomalocaris school badge!
We'll only show up to Rank 3 here; you'll have to find out what Ranks 4 and above look like yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42877421/1afa83dd6e8c5e99c09da51b65092f3cacef6464.png[/img]

Even if you've already beaten all the routes, why not give the game another spin? Maybe you'll find out something new!
We wish you luck on getting your favorite character's trading card!

notes.title: From Madness with Love is out NOW!!!!!!
notes.content:
From Madness with Love, the dating sim with guys you will never be on the same page with, officially released TODAY!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42877421/62a7c8b6d6b8df3a0b3ce2652a35cf2e0ac31c84.png[/img]
(Translation: Bake fair~)
("What does that even mean?" Don't worry about it.)

During Steam Next Fest, we received a lot of positive reviews from streamers and regular players alike for the demo, and we hope it could give you a taste of the wacky yet mysterious and madness-inducing world of the game, as well as the fully-voiced gibberish that really couldn't be done justice just from screenshots and trailers alone.

We've made a few tweaks to the game according to feedback we received during Steam Next Fest. We couldn't do everything that was suggested, but we've added things such as a volume setting for sound effects, so if you're easily startled by or just do not like the weird and loud sounds that the game throws at you, you can now turn them down in the settings.

Well then, we hope you enjoy the full madness-filled experience!!

By the way, we would LOVE to see your reviews, thoughts, and even fan work (!!!), so post them in the Steam forums or on social media so we can see them! We WILL cry.

(If you're on Twitter, the hashtags for fanart are #狂気より愛をこめてFA and #fMwLFA)

We've also collected some frequently asked questions and answered them here!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2101130/discussions/0/3819663388891453920/
